settings.label: Rendering mode
settings.why: Epic's lightweight renderer: far less to draw, the same information on screen.

settings.label: Frame rate limit
settings.why: Capped at your monitor's refresh rate for steady frame times.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.why: V-Sync holds frames back, which adds input lag.

settings.label: NVIDIA Reflex
settings.why: Cuts the delay between your click and the shot on NVIDIA cards. Other cards ignore it.

settings.label: Motion blur
settings.why: Blur hides the movement you need to track.

settings.label: Ray tracing
settings.why: A large frame cost with no competitive value.

settings.label: 3D resolution
settings.why: Anything below your native resolution makes players blurrier.

settings.label: View distance
settings.why: Kept at Epic on purpose: players and builds stay drawn at the longest range.

settings.label: Shadows
settings.why: Shadows redraw the scene from each light. Off skips that work.

settings.label: Post processing
settings.why: Removes bloom and haze layered over the scene.

settings.label: Effects
settings.why: Less particle clutter when fights get busy.

settings.label: Textures
settings.why: Frees video memory. Sharper textures don't show you anything new.
